about: Question 10 (A), decided by the owner on 2026-09-16. Control test 4.7 holds today's engine to this written prediction of how its capture of the control corpus differs from the stored control capture (tools/control-corpus.json, controlCapture): every difference with its kind, scenario, path, and reference and candidate values, exactly as tools/differential-harness.js reports them. A difference found and not declared, or declared and not found, fails 4.7; a category or a pattern approves nothing. An output-moving commit declares its differences here, with its reason under changes, before it lands. Historical integrity, whether the stored capture is what its own engine computed, is a separate check (tools/historical-replay.js). Restarted on 2026-10-03 against s5aa-r51-control (S5AA R51, the owner's successor-control decision): every declaration made against s5-control (62 changes, 15971 differences, S5 R5 to S5AA R50) is kept in this file's history at 5119d03; against the successor, only movement since b722884 is declared.

changes.change: S5AA R51 against the successor control s5aa-r51-control (captured at b722884, which already holds decision 1, flexibility off by default): the owner's decisions of 2026-10-03 -- the Medicare charge of each person starts at their own medicareStartAge() (one Medicare date); employment and self-employment streams count as pay in the working-years check, net of the payroll, self-employment and income tax they add (the owner's D3 ruling); the optimizer's Roth weight is the cost of the next dollar drawn (rothNextDollarWeight, the owner's ruling on R50 section 8 item 2)
changes.why: predicted by audit/S5AA/R51/S5AA_R51_PREDICTION_RECORD_20261003.md (d663f16) and S5AA_R51_PREDICTION_ADDENDUM_20261003.md (7f1e131); measured in audit/S5AA/R51/S5AA_R51_BUILD_REPORT_20261003.md. The nine working-years message texts and seed:16's last-bit spending come from 8732bb8; golden:monte-carlo-fixed-seed's eleven (its published median and 10th-percentile rows and the carried-up Roth basis disclosure) from 2f73b85

differences.reference: The working years are not funded by pay: at age 58 the year's pay, after payroll and income tax, does not cover the contributions and debt payments (with any mortgage insurance) made while working, by about $71,030. The plan has no budget for the working years, so it does not say where that money comes from; check the contributions and debt payments against take-home pay. Pay here is salary: an employment or self-employment income entered as an income source is outside income, kept or invested by the surplus setting.
